# Libraries

```{r message=FALSE}
library(HDF5Array)
#library(Seurat)
library(SingleCellExperiment) # just for testing
library(cellhashR)
library(DropletUtils)
library(scater)
library(scuttle)
library(scales)
library(ggExtra)

# DropletUtils::read10xCounts()
```

```{r}
set.seed(12)
```

```{r}
# rna-seq & atac-seq
h5ls("data/muA/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
# hto tags
h5ls("data/muA/muAh/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
```




```{r data_manipulation, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Splitting data ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
## Expression data
gene_exp <- tenx[grep("ENS", rownames(tenx)),]
# setting gene names from feature group in h5 file. Filtering is done to get only genes.
row.names(gene_exp) <- as.character(HDF5Array("data/muA/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5", "/matrix/features/name")[
  grep("^G",HDF5Array("data/muA/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5", "/matrix/features/feature_type"))])

#'* I don't know what to do with the intervals *
ranges_mrna <- h5read("data/muA/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5", "/matrix/features/interval")[
  grep("^G",HDF5Array("data/muA/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5", "/matrix/features/feature_type"))]

## ATAC data
atac <- tenx[grep("ENS", rownames(tenx), invert = TRUE),]
# setting gene names from feature group in h5 file. Filtering is done to get only peaks.
rownames(atac) <- as.character(HDF5Array("data/muA/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5", "/matrix/features/name")[nrow(gene_exp)+1:nrow(atac)])

```


```{r reading_htos_before, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# ============= subsetting by HTO tags ===============
##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

length(intersect(colnames(gene_exp), colnames(htos))) #20.000

gene_exp <- gene_exp[, intersect(colnames(gene_exp), colnames(htos))]
htos <- htos[, intersect(colnames(gene_exp), colnames(htos))]
```


```{r single_cell_object, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts=gene_exp),
                            colData=list(t(htos))) # IDN why it adds a new column: "sizeFactor"
                           
sce <- scuttle::logNormCounts(sce)

#'* It's possible to add per-cell QC metrics *
sce <- addPerCellQCMetrics(sce, subset=list(Mito=rownames(rowData(sce))[grep("mt-", rownames(rowData(sce)))]))
```

# Data Loading & SCE object creation

```{r}
sce <- read10xCounts("data/muA/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
sce <- splitAltExps(sce, rowData(sce)[, "Type"])
sce <- swapAltExp(sce, "Gene Expression")
rownames(sce) <- make.unique(rowData(sce)$Symbol)
colnames(sce) <- colData(sce)$"Barcode"
```

```{r}
sce
```


*To add HTOs as metadata, remember to perform the intersection counts-htos*


```{r}
# using DropletUtils::read10xCounts
htos <- read10xCounts("data/muA/muAh/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
colnames(htos) <- htos$Barcode
htos <- htos[, intersect(colnames(sce), colnames(htos))]
```

```{r}
# make sure that the colnames are the same in both assays
stopifnot(setequal(colnames(htos), colnames(sce)))

```

*Adding hto information as alternative experiment*

```{r}
altExp(sce, "hto") <- SummarizedExperiment(assay(htos))

# hto can be removed
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# getting a list of cellbarcode
fileConn <- file(file.path("peralta_qc/out/cellbarcodeWhitelist.txt"))
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# swapping experiment to hto and subsetting rownames by HTO-tag, list of interest.
write.table(assay(swapAltExp(sce, "hto"))[rownames(assay(swapAltExp(sce, "hto"))) %in% HTO_tag,],
            file = "peralta_qc/out/hto.txt", sep = ",", col.names = TRUE, row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
pdf(file.path("peralta_qc/pdf/hto.pdf"), width = 20, height = 20)

barcodeData <- ProcessCountMatrix(rawCountData = "peralta_qc/out/hto.txt",
                                  minCountPerCell = 5,
                                  simplifyBarcodeNames = FALSE,
                                  cellbarcodeWhitelist = "peralta_qc/out/cellbarcodeWhitelist.txt",
                                  barcodeWhitelist = HTO_tag)

methods=c("multiseq","gmm_demux", "htodemux", "dropletutils")
calls <- GenerateCellHashingCalls(barcodeMatrix = barcodeData,
                                  methods = methods, 
                                  doTSNE = FALSE,
                                  majorityConsensusThreshold = 0.3)
# create summary plots to contrast cells based on call-status. Help inform why some cells were not called
SummarizeCellsByClassification(calls = calls, barcodeMatrix = barcodeData)
dev.off()
```


# QC Metrics with scuttle/scater

## QC, mito-ribo

The `sum` column contains the total count for each cell and the `detected` column contains the number of detected genes. The `subsets_Mito_percent` column contains the percentage of reads mapped to mitochondrial transcripts. Finally, the `altexps_ERCC_percent` column contains the percentage of reads mapped to ERCC transcripts.

```{r}

sce <- addPerCellQCMetrics(sce, subset=list(Mito=rownames(rowData(sce))[grep("mt-", rownames(rowData(sce)))],
                                            Ribo=rownames(rowData(sce))[grep("(^Rpl|^Rps|Mrp)",
                                                                             rownames(rowData(sce)))]))

```

## Relation between nUMI and nGene deteced

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ nGenes vs nUMIs ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

p1 <- plotColData(sce, x="sum" , y="detected",
            colour_by = "subsets_Mito_percent",
            size_by = "subsets_Ribo_percent") + 
  scale_colour_gradient(aesthetics = c("colour"),low = "gray90", high = "black") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+
  xlab("nCount_RNA")+
  ylab("nFeature_RNA")+ 
  ggtitle(NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "left") +
  labs(colour="percent.mito") +
  guides(size=guide_legend("percent.ribo"))

p1 <- ggMarginal(p1, type = "densigram",bins=100, fill="grey", alpha=.3)

p1
```

```{r warning=FALSE}

  p
}
```

## Filtering metrics


### setting a column where to store QC control information

```{r}
# filtering by mito genes: sce[, sce$subsets_Mito_percent <= mito_max]
# filtering by min_rna : sce_Mito_filt[, log10(sce_Mito_filt$detected) >= min_nfeatures]
# filtering by valid_cells: sce_mito_rna_filt[, sce_mito_rna_filt$validCells]
# column name: qc
# gplots::venn
```


```{r}

colData(sce)$qc <- gsub("TRUE", "passed", gsub("FALSE", "fails_maxMito", sce$subsets_Mito_percent <= mito_max))
colData(sce)$qc <- 
  replace(x=colData(sce)$qc,
          list=which(sce$qc == "passed"),
          values=gsub(
            "TRUE", "passed", gsub("FALSE", "fails_minFeat", log10(sce[,sce$qc == "passed"]$detected)
                                   >=min_nfeatures)))

lm <- lm(log10(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"]$detected) ~ log10(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"]$sum))

colData(sce)$qc <- 
  replace(x=colData(sce)$qc,
          list=which(sce$qc =="passed"),
          values=gsub(
            "TRUE", "passed",
            gsub("FALSE", "fails_lm",
                 log10(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"]$detected) > 
                   log10(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"]$sum) * lm$coefficients[2] + (lm$coefficients[1]-.09))))
```

\##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Filter cells based on maxMito & minFeat ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

`line 412`


```{r nGenesvsUMIs_cutoff, warning=FALSE}
p2 <- plotColData(sce[, !sce$qc == "fails_maxMito" & !sce$qc == "fails_minFeat"],
                  x="sum", y="detected",
        colour_by="subsets_Mito_percent",
        size_by="subsets_Ribo_percent") +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() + 
  scale_colour_gradient(aesthetics = c("colour"),low = "gray90", high = "black") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", show.legend = FALSE)+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 10^min_nfeatures), colour = "darkgreen", linetype = 2)+
  geom_abline(intercept = lm$coefficients[1] - 0.09, slope = lm$coefficients[2], color="orange") +
  xlab("log10(nCount_RNA)")+
  ylab("log10(nFeature_RNA)") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "left") +
  labs(colour="percent.mito") +
  guides(size=guide_legend("percent.ribo")) +
  annotate(geom = "text",size=4, label = paste0(dim(sce[, !sce$qc == "fails_maxMito" & !sce$qc == "fails_minFeat"])[2], " QC passed cells"),
           x = 1000, y = 5000)

p2 <- ggMarginal(p2, type = "densigram",bins=100, fill="grey", alpha=.3)

p2
```


\# cells to exclude lie below an intercept offset of -0.09


```{r nGenesvsnUMIs_validCells, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
p3 <- plotColData(sce[, !sce$qc == "fails_maxMito" & !sce$qc == "fails_minFeat"],
                  x="sum", y="detected",
            colour_by = "qc") +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("darkred", "dodgerblue")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color="black",show.legend = FALSE)+
  geom_abline(intercept = lm$coefficients[1] - 0.09, slope = lm$coefficients[2], color="orange") +
  xlab("log10(nCount_RNA)")+
  ylab("log10(nFeature_RNA)") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "left") +
```

\# SCE data structure


```{r eval=FALSE}
library(parallel)
system.time(
mclapply(seq(1, 20000, by = 1000), FUN = function(i, x) {
        DelayedMatrixStats::colSums2(x = x, cols = i:(i+999))
    },
    x = h5matrix, mc.cores = 4)
)
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
#counts_sum0 <- rowSums(assay(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"][1:1000, 1:1100])) # 1100 cells 
#counts_sum1 <- colSums(assay(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"][1:1000, 1:1100])) 
#counts_sum <- sum(assay(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"][1:1000, 1:1100]))


counts_sum0 <- rowSums(assay(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"])) # 1100 cells 
counts_sum1 <- colSums(assay(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"])) 
counts_sum <- sum(assay(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"])) # sum of the cols sum
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
mu <- DelayedArray(crossprod(t(counts_sum0), counts_sum1) / counts_sum)

#colnames(mu) <- colnames(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"])

z <- DelayedArray((assay(sce[, sce$qc == "passed"]) - mu) / sqrt(mu + (mu**2/theta)))
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#' Generates a grid plot with UMAP coordinates coloured by a list containing the name of gene markers of interest
#' @param sce_object a SingeCellExperiment object containing the information needed to subset & plot
#' @param gene_list a character list containing the names of the gene markers of interest
#' @param dim_red the name of the reducedDimNames meta data to plot. Default to "UMAP_resid"
#' @param expr_values the name of the assaysNames to use when retrieving feature information
#' @return cowplot::plot_grid object

plot_genes_markers <- function(sce_object, gene_list, dimred="UMAP_resid", expr_values="pearson_resid"){
  plt <- local({
    plotFUN <- function(gene){
      plotReducedDim(sce_object, dimred =dimred,
               colour_by = gene,
               by_exprs_values = expr_values,
               point_size=.1) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "grey", high = "blue") +
      labs(colour=NULL, title = gene) +
      coord_equal()
    }
    p <- base::Map(plotFUN, gene_list)
    p <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = p, ncol = 4, align = "hv")
    p
  })
  
  plt
}

p <- plot_genes_markers(sce_2, gene_list = genes)
```
